title.quote:
Training Plug-and-Play Knowledge Modules
with Deep Context Distillation
title.value: Training Plug-and-Play Knowledge Modules with Deep Context Distillation

extractions.description: The paper proposes document-level Knowledge Modules (KMs) implemented as LoRA adapters, trained with a Deep Context Distillation (DCD) objective that matches hidden states and logits of a teacher conditioned on the document. Evaluated on QuALITY, NarrativeQA and LongHealth with Phi-3 3B and Llama-3.1 8B, in closed-book and open-book (RAG, ICL) settings, with synthetic data generation (summaries, QA pairs, Entigraph) from GPT-4o.

type.quote: We evaluate our method on two long-context question answering datasets (QuALITY and NarrativeQA) and two base models (Phi-3 3B and Llama-3.1 8B)
type.justification: The paper reports experiments and benchmark tables.
